description: Run a Blade Element Momentum (BEM) steady-state simulation in QBlade. A complete NREL 5MW rotor configuration (airfoils, 360-degree polars, blade design, and rotor definition) has been pre-loaded as a sample project. Open QBlade, load the NREL 5MW project from /home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/, and navigate to the BEM simulation module. Create and run a steady-state BEM simulation with a tip speed ratio (TSR) sweep. After the simulation completes, export the results (Cp vs TSR data) to /home/ga/Documents/projects/bem_results.txt.
